qe: Which organization calculates National Income in India?
qh: भारत में राष्ट्रीय आय की गणना कौन सा संगठन करता है?
e: Desh ki rashtriy aay ka aakda rastriya saankhyiki karyalaya yaani National Statistical Office tay karta hai; isi ka hisaab GDP tatha mehngai ke bade naapon ka aadhar banta hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo National Statistical Office ko yah kaam deta hai. Is karyalaya ke aakdon par sarkar ki niti tatha duniya ke saamne desh ki haalat tay hoti hai; isliye ise bharosemand tarike se hisaab rakhna padta hai. NITI Aayog sirf salah deta hai, vitta mantralaya budget banata hai tatha RBI ka kaam bankon ki nigrani hai, isliye aakda nikaalne ka thika inmein koi nahi leta. Baaki teen vikalp is hisaab ke nahi hain. Exam point: aakda nikaalne ki zimmewari NSO ke paas hai - isi ke aakde sarkar ki niti ka aadhar bante hain.

qe: Which of the following is the most appropriate measure of a country's economic growth?
qh: किसी देश के आर्थिक विकास का सबसे उपयुक्त माप निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा है?
e: Kisi desh ke aarthik vikas ka sabse behtar naap asli per capita aay yaani badhti aabadi ke hisaab se har vyakti ki asli kamai hai; isliye ismein mehngai ka asar bhi nikal diya jaata hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jismein asli per capita aay ka naap bataya gaya hai. Yah naap isliye sabse behtar mana jaata hai ki kul aay badhti hui aabadi ke saath badhti bhi reh sakti hai; isliye har vyakti ki asli kamai hi batati hai ki logon ka jeevan star sudhra ya nahi. GNP, rashtriy aay tatha GDP keval kul aakde hain, isliye ye aabadi tatha mehngai ka asar dikhaye bina vikas ka sahi chitra nahi dete. Baaki vikalp is naap ke sahi nahi hain. Exam point: arthik vikas ka sabse behtar naap asli per capita aay hai - yahi aabadi tatha mehngai dono ka asar dikhata hai.

qe: What is the formula for calculating 'NNP at Factor Cost'?
qh: 'साधन लागत पर NNP' की गणना करने का सूत्र क्या है?
o: NNP at Market Price - Indirect Taxes + Subsidies
e: Sadhan laagat par NNP nikaalne ke liye bazaar keemat wali NNP mein se apratyaksh kar ghataye jaate hain tatha sabsidi jodi jaati hai; isliye yah aakda desh ke logon ki asli kamai batata hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo apratyaksh kar ghatane tatha sabsidi jodne ka sootra deta hai. Yah badlav isliye kiya jaata hai ki bazaar ki keemat mein sarkar ka kar shaamil hota hai; isliye us kar ko hataakar hi sadhan ki asli laagat dikhti hai. GDP mein videshi sadhan aay jodna, GNP mein se mulya-kshaya ghatana tatha GNP mein sabsidi jodna alag alag sootra hain, isliye ye teeno theek nahi baithte. Baaki teen sootra is hisaab ke nahi hain. Exam point: sadhan laagat par NNP = bazaar keemat wali NNP ghata apratyaksh kar jod sabsidi - yahi sootra ahem hai.

qe: The value of all final goods and services produced within the boundary of a country is called?
qh: किसी देश की सीमा के भीतर उत्पादित सभी अंतिम वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के मूल्य को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Desh ki seema ke andar ek saal mein bani sabhi antim vastuon tatha sevaon ki keemat ko GDP yaani sakal gharelu utpad kaha jaata hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo GDP ko is tarah paribhashit karta hai. Seema ke andar hone wale har kaam ka kandha ke hisaab se aakda isliye kiya jaata hai ki videshi nagrik bhi desh ke andar ke kaam mein shaamil ho jaate hain; isliye ye desh ke andar ki taakat dikhata hai. NNP tatha GNP videshi sadhan aay ke saath jude hain tatha shuddh rashtriy aay NNP hi hai, isliye ye teeno is paribhasha ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is paribhasha ke nahi baithte. Exam point: desh ki seema ke andar ke antim utpad ki keemat GDP hai - yahi sabse badi pehchan hai.

qe: What is 'Depreciation' in national income accounting?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आय लेखांकन में 'मूल्यह्रास' (Depreciation) क्या है?
o: Loss of value of fixed capital due to wear and tear
e: Mulya-kshaya yaani Depreciation ka matlab hai mashin, imaarat tatha anya asthir punji ka ghisi-chuk kar tatha purane ho kar kam ho jaane wala mulya. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo ghisi-chuk kar mulya ghatne ki baat karta hai. Ise alag isliye ginte hain ki isse utpadan mein lagne wali punji ka asli kharch saaf dikhe; isliye sadhan laagat par aakde mein punji ki ye ghisvat bhi jodkar dekhi jaati hai. Koi nahi, sampatti ka badhna tatha aay par lagne wala kar ise nahi batate, kyunki ghisvat ka asli matlab punji ke mulya ka girna hai. Baaki teen vikalp is shabd ke nahi hain. Exam point: mulya-kshaya asthir punji ke ghisi-chuk hone ka nuksan hai - ise ghatakar hi shuddh aakde milte hain.

qe: Which of the following is NOT included in National Income?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किसे राष्ट्रीय आय में शामिल नहीं किया जाता है?
e: Hastantaran bhugtan jaise pension tatha chhatravritti rashtriy aay mein nahi jode jaate, kyunki inke badle koi nayi vastu ya seva paida nahi hoti. Chauthe vikalp sahi hai, jo pension jaisa hastantaran bhugtan batata hai. Yah baat isliye hai ki rashtriy aay keval utpadan ki kamai ginnti hai; isliye jahan koi cheez paida nahi hoti wahan sirf paisa haath badalta hai tatha ginti mein nahi aata. Tankha, kiraya tatha labh utpadan ke badle mile bhugtan hain, isliye ye teeno rashtriy aay mein ginne wale hisse hain. Baaki teen vikalp is ginti ke nahi hain. Exam point: pension jaisa hastantaran bhugtan rashtriy aay mein nahi joda jaata - kyunki uske badle koi utpadan nahi hota.

qe: What is 'NFIA' in National Income terminology?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आय शब्दावली में 'NFIA' क्या है?
e: NFIA ka poora naam Net Factor Income from Abroad hai, tatha yah desh ke logon dwara videsh se kamayi gai sadhan aay tatha videsh mein diye gaye bhugtan ka phark batata hai. Doosra vikalp sahi hai, jo Net Factor Income from Abroad batata hai. Yah aakda isliye ahem hai ki GDP mein ise jodne par GNP milta hai; isliye videsh mein kaam karne walon ki kamai tatha baahar bheje gaye labh isi ke hisaab mein aate hain. National Finance India Association, koi nahi tatha New Foreign Investment Act jaise naam is shabd ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is aakde ke nahi hain. Exam point: NFIA desh ke logon ki videsh se kamayi ka shuddh hisaab hai - GDP mein ise jodne par GNP banta hai.

qe: When National Income is calculated at 'Constant Prices', it is called?
qh: जब राष्ट्रीय आय की गणना 'स्थिर कीमतों' पर की जाती है, तो उसे क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Jab rashtriy aay ko ek hi aadhaar saal ki keemat par naapkar nikaala jaata hai to use asli rashtriy aay kaha jaata hai; isliye mehngai ke badhne-ghatne ka asar is aakde mein nahi dikhta. Doosra vikalp sahi hai, jo asli rashtriy aay batata hai. Ise isliye nikaala jaata hai ki chalu keematon ki ginti mein mehngai ka asar badhotri mein mil jaata hai; isliye sachchi badhotri dekhne ke liye ek purane saal ki keematein pakad li jaati hain. Vyaktiye aay, kharch layak aay tatha chalu keematon wali rashtriy aay is shabd ke sahi naam nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is aay ke naap ke nahi hain. Exam point: asli rashtriy aay ek hi aadhaar saal ki keematon par naapi jaati hai - isse mehngai ka asar alag ho jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Disposable Personal Income'?
qh: 'प्रयोज्य व्यक्तिगत आय' (Disposable Personal Income) क्या है?
e: Prayojya vyaktiye aay yaani Disposable Personal Income wo paisa hai jo vyakti ki kul praptiyon mein se pratyaksh kar kaatkar uske paas kharch karne ke liye bachta hai. Doosra vikalp sahi hai, jo pratyaksh kar ghatane ki baat karta hai. Yah aakda isliye dekha jaata hai ki khapat tatha bachat isi bache paise se hoti hai; isliye ise kharch ki asli taakat bhi kaha jaata hai. Kar se pehle ki aay, kul tankha tatha GNP mein sabsidi jodna is aakde ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is aakde ke nahi hain. Exam point: prayojya vyaktiye aay = vyaktiye aay ghata pratyaksh kar - yahi kharch ki asli taakat hai.

qe: What is the 'Base Year' currently used by NSO for National Income accounting in India?
qh: भारत में राष्ट्रीय आय लेखांकन के लिए NSO द्वारा वर्तमान में किस 'आधार वर्ष' का उपयोग किया जा रहा है?
e: NSO abhi rashtriy aay ke aakdon ke liye do hazaar gyarah-barah wale aadhaar saal ki nayi shrinkhla istemal kar rahi hai; isliye isi saal ki keematon ko aadhar maankar aakde nikaale jaate hain. Chauthe vikalp sahi hai, jo 2011-12 wala aadhaar saal batata hai. Aadhaar saal badalne ka maksad yah hota hai ki kaam-dhandhe ka dhaancha badal jaane par ginti purani na rahe; isliye nayi kaarobar tatha banking ke aakde ismein jode jaate hain. 2020-21, 2004-05 tatha 2015-16 wale saal is samay ke aadhaar saal nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is aadhaar saal ke nahi hain. Exam point: rashtriy aay ki ginti ka aadhaar saal 2011-12 hai - nayi shrinkhla isi par khadi hai.

qe: Which of the following methods is NOT used to calculate National Income?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आय की गणना के लिए निम्नलिखित में से किस पद्धति का उपयोग नहीं किया जाता है?
e: Rashtriy aay nikaalne ke teen asli tarike hain - utpadan ke raste wali vidhi, aay wali vidhi tatha vyay wali vidhi; isliye nivesh wali vidhi naam ka koi alag tarika nahi hota. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo Investment Method ko alag dikhata hai. Nivesh ke aakde vyay wali vidhi ke andar hi aate hain, isliye ushe alag tarika maan lena galti hoti hai. Vyay wali vidhi, utpadan wali vidhi tatha aay wali vidhi ko aksar istemal kiya jaata hai, isliye yah teeno ginti ke tarike hain tatha galat vikalp nahi hain. Baaki teen vikalp asli tarike hain. Exam point: rashtriy aay ke teen tarike - utpadan, aay tatha vyay - hain; nivesh wali vidhi alag se nahi hoti.

qe: What is the 'GDP Deflator' used for?
qh: 'जीडीपी डिफ्लेटर' (GDP Deflator) का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
o: Measuring the general price level (inflation) in an economy
e: GDP difletar yaani GDP Deflator is baat ka naap hai ki ek desh mein saal bhar mein aam keematon ka star kitna badla; isliye yah mehngai ka sabse chauda aakda mana jaata hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo aam keematon ka star yaani mehngai naapne ki baat karta hai. Yah naap isliye ahem hai ki ismein desh mein bane sabhi saaman tatha sevaon ki keematein aa jaati hain; isliye ek-do cheezon ke mehnge hone ka poora asar ismein dikhta hai. Kar vasooli ka hisaab, koi nahi tatha berozgari ka naap is aakde ke kaam ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is naap ke nahi hain. Exam point: GDP difletar aam keematon ka star naapkar mehngai batata hai - yahi sabse chauda naap hai.

qe: What is 'Green GDP'?
qh: 'ग्रीन जीडीपी' (Green GDP) क्या है?
o: GDP adjusted for environmental degradation and natural resource depletion
e: Green GDP ek aisa sudhra aakda hai jismein desh ke badhne ke saath jungle tatha khaniz sampatti ke ghatne ka tatha pradushan ka nuksan bhi hisaab se kaat liya jaata hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo paryavaran ke nuksan ko ghatane ki baat karta hai. Yah vichaar isliye aaya ki keval badhne ka aakda kaat-cheer tatha pradushan se hone wale nuksan ko chhupa deta hai; isliye asli labh dekhne ke liye ye nuksan ghatana zaroori hai. Koi nahi, sirf kheti ka aakda tatha jungle ilaake ka aakda is shabd ke sahi matlab nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is aakde ke nahi hain. Exam point: Green GDP paryavaran ke nuksan ko ghatakar nikaala jaata hai - isse asli taraqqi dikhti hai.

qe: In the Expenditure Method, which of the following is included?
qh: व्यय विधि में निम्नलिखित में से किसे शामिल किया जाता है?
e: Vyay wali vidhi mein ek saal mein desh mein jitna paisa kharch hua wo sab joda jaata hai, jaise grahakon ka kharch, nivesh, sarkar ka kharch tatha niryat mein se aayat ka phark. Chauthe vikalp sahi hai, jo chaar hisson wala poora sootra deta hai. Iska fayda yah hai ki kharch ka aakda kar ke aasani se mil jaata hai; isliye bazaar mein bikri tatha sampatti banne ka poora hisaab isi mein aa jaata hai. Keval khapat, labh-kiraya-tankha ka jod tatha GNP mein se NNP ghatana is poore sootra ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is sootra ke nahi hain. Exam point: vyay wali vidhi ka sootra khapat jod nivesh jod sarkari kharch jod niryat ghata aayat hai - ise yaad rakhein.

qe: Which organizations provide the data and report for the 'Global Hunger Index'?
qh: 'ग्लोबल हंगर इंडेक्स' के लिए रिपोर्ट और डेटा कौन से संगठन तैयार करते हैं?
e: Bhookh ke aakde tatha riporat ko bhookh ke aakde wali do sansthaayein yaani Concern Worldwide tatha Welthungerhilfe milkar taiyar karti hain. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jo inhi do sansthaon ke naam batata hai. Yah soochak isliye kaam aata hai ki chhote bachon ki haalat tatha khaane ki kami ka poora chitra mil sake; isliye yah bhookh ke chaar hisson ko jodkar ek ankh bana deti hai. World Bank tatha IMF paise ka kaam dekhte hain, UNDP tatha UNICEF vikas tatha bachon ke anya aakde dete hain tatha FAO tatha WHO khaane tatha swasthya ki baatein dekhte hain, isliye ye is riporat ke sahi naam nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is riporat ke nahi hain. Exam point: Global Hunger Index Concern Worldwide tatha Welthungerhilfe milkar nikaalti hain - yahi bhookh ka saalana aakda hai.

qe: What is 'National Income' technically equal to?
qh: 'राष्ट्रीय आय' वास्तव में किसके बराबर होती है?
e: Rashtriy aay sadhan laagat par NNP ke barabar hoti hai, kyunki ismein desh ke logon ki kamai ki saari laagatein aa jaati hain tatha mulya-kshaya tatha apratyaksh kar ka asar hat jaata hai. Chauthe vikalp sahi hai, jo sadhan laagat par NNP batata hai. Rashtriy aay ka yah roop logon ki asli kamai ka sabse saaf chitra isliye deta hai ki ismein bazaar ke kar tatha purani punji ka bojh alag kar diya gaya hai. Bazaar keemat par NNP tatha GNP ke aakde kar ke bina ke hote hain tatha sadhan laagat par GDP isse chhota aakda hai, isliye ye theek nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is baat ke nahi hain. Exam point: rashtriy aay = sadhan laagat par NNP - yahi paribhasha yaad rakhein.

qe: Who gave the 'Scientific Method' of estimating National Income in India for the first time?
qh: भारत में पहली बार राष्ट्रीय आय के अनुमान की 'वैज्ञानिक पद्धति' किसने दी थी?
e: Bharat mein rashtriy aay ka pehla vaigyanik tatha poora anumaan V.K.R.V. Rao ne diya tha, tatha usmein utpadan tatha kamai dono ke aakde jode gaye the. Chauthe vikalp sahi hai, jo V.K.R.V. Rao ka naam batata hai. Yah kaam isliye ahem tha ki usse pehle ke aakde adhure tarikon par bane the; isliye is anumaan se hi aage ki saari ginti ka bharosa bana. D.R. Gadgil tatha P.C. Mahalanobis baad ke samay mein samiti tatha yojna ke kaam se jude the tatha Dadabhai Naoroji ne apne tark se anumaan lagaya tha, isliye vaigyanik tarika unka nahi hai. Baaki vikalp is anumaan ke nahi hain. Exam point: pehla vaigyanik rashtriy aay anumaan V.K.R.V. Rao ne diya - unhe is kshetra ka aguva maana jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Personal Income'?
qh: 'व्यक्तिगत आय' (Personal Income) क्या है?
o: Total income received by individuals from all sources before direct taxes
e: Vyaktiye aay yaani Personal Income ka matlab hai kisi vyakti ko saal bhar mein sabhi zariyon se prapt hui kul kamai, isse pehle ki usmein se pratyaksh kar kaata jaye. Doosra vikalp sahi hai, jo pratyaksh kar se pehle wali kul prapti batata hai. Yah aakda isliye alag dekha jaata hai ki vyakti ki kamai sabhi zariyon ko jodne se hi uska kharch tatha bachat ka andaaza lagta hai. Companyon ki kamai, rashtriy aay mein mulya-kshaya jodna tatha koi nahi wala vikalp is kamai ke sahi nahi baithe. Baaki vikalpon ka is kamai se koi naata nahi. Exam point: vyaktiye aay vyakti ki sabhi zariyon ki kamai hai - usmein se kar kaatne par prayojya aay banti hai.

qe: Which of the following is an example of an 'Intermediate Good'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'मध्यवर्ती वस्तु' (Intermediate Good) का उदाहरण है?
o: A car sold to a consumer
A laptop used by a student
Flour used by a baker to make bread
e: Madhyavarti vastu yaani Intermediate Good wo cheez hai jo aage banne wale maal mein lag jaati hai, jaise roti banane mein lagne wala aata; isliye yah cheez apne aap mein bikri ke liye tayyar nahi hoti. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo aate ka udaharan deta hai. Aisi cheezon ki keemat antim maal mein hi ginni chaahiye, warna ek hi cheez do baar gine jaane ki galti ho jaati hai; isliye rashtriy aay mein keval antim vastuon ka mulya aata hai. Grahak ko bika kaar, chhaatr ka laptop tatha rehne ke liye kharida ghar antim vastuon ke udaharan hain, isliye ye madhyavarti ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki teen vikalp is udaharan ke nahi hain. Exam point: roti banane wala aata madhyavarti vastu hai - ek hi cheez ko do baar ginne se bachne ke liye ise alag rakha jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Gross National Product' (GNP)?
qh: 'सकल राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद' (GNP) क्या है?
o: GDP + Net Factor Income from Abroad
e: Sakal rashtriy utpad yaani GNP nikaalne ke liye GDP mein videsh se mili shuddh sadhan aay jodi jaati hai; isliye desh ke logon ki kamai videsh mein hone par bhi ismein aa jaati hai. Doosra vikalp sahi hai, jo GDP mein videshi sadhan aay jodne ki baat karta hai. Yah jod isliye kiya jaata hai ki desh ki seema ke bahar rahne wale nagrik bhi rashtriy aay mein ginti hain; isliye videsh se aane wali kamai ko jodna zaroori hai. Keval desh ke andar ka utpad, GDP mein se apratyaksh kar ghatana tatha GDP mein mulya-kshaya jodna is sootra ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is hisaab ke nahi hain. Exam point: GNP = GDP jod videsh se shuddh sadhan aay - yahi sootra aksar poochha jaata hai.

qe: What is the difference between GDP and NDP?
qh: जीडीपी (GDP) और एनडीपी (NDP) के बीच क्या अंतर है?
e: GDP tatha NDP ka phark keval mulya-kshaya ka hota hai; NDP nikaalne ke liye GDP mein se punji ki ghisvat ghatai jaati hai. Chauthe vikalp sahi hai, jo mulya-kshaya ko phark batata hai. Yah ghatav isliye kiya jaata hai ki purani mashin tatha imaarat ke ghise hone ka bojh hataakar asli naya utpadan dikhe. Sabsidi, videshi sadhan aay tatha apratyaksh kar is phark ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is phark ke nahi hain. Exam point: GDP ghata mulya-kshaya = NDP - yahi ek hi badlav hai.

qe: Which committee was appointed in 1949 under P.C. Mahalanobis to estimate National Income?
qh: 1949 में राष्ट्रीय आय का अनुमान लगाने के लिए पी.सी. महालनोबिस की अध्यक्षता में किस समिति का गठन किया गया था?
e: Sann 1949 mein rashtriy aay ka anumaan lagane ke liye P.C. Mahalanobis ki adhyakshta wali rashtriy aay samiti banaayi gayi thi, jismein V.K.R.V. Rao tatha D.R. Gadgil bhi sadasya the. Chauthe vikalp sahi hai, jo rashtriy aay samiti ko iska naam deta hai. Yah samiti isliye banayi gayi ki aazadi ke baad desh ke aakde ka poora dhaancha khada karna tha; isliye iske anumaan hi aage ke budget tatha yojnaon ka aadhar bane. Vitta ayog kar baantne ki sanstha hai, yojna ayog purani sanstha hai tatha NITI Aayog uske badle aayi hui salahkar sanstha hai. Baaki vikalp is samiti ke nahi hain. Exam point: rashtriy aay samiti 1949 mein Mahalanobis ki adhyakshta mein bani - yahi pehla bada anumaan tha.

qe: What is 'GDP at Market Price'?
qh: 'बाजार मूल्य पर जीडीपी' क्या है?
o: GDP at Factor Cost + Indirect Taxes - Subsidies
e: Bazaar keemat par GDP nikaalne ke liye sadhan laagat par GDP mein apratyaksh kar jode jaate hain tatha sabsidi ghatayi jaati hai; isliye yah aakda bazaar mein jo keemat chukayi gayi wo dikhata hai. Pehla vikalp sahi hai, jismein apratyaksh kar jodne tatha sabsidi ghatane ka sootra diya gaya hai. Yah badlav isliye zaroori hai ki bikri ki keemat ke andar sarkar ka kar chhupa hota hai, par utpadak ki laagat mein woh kar nahi hota; isliye dono naapon ka phark samajhna ahem hai. Koi nahi, sadhan laagat par GDP mein se mulya-kshaya ghatana tatha keval kheti ka aakda is sootra ke sahi nahi hain. Baaki teen vikalp is sootra ke nahi hain. Exam point: bazaar keemat par GDP = sadhan laagat wali GDP jod apratyaksh kar ghata sabsidi - yahi sootra hai.

qe: Which method of National Income calculation evaluates 'Value Added' at each stage of production?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आय की गणना की किस पद्धति में प्रत्येक चरण में 'मूल्य वर्धित' की गणना की जाती है?
e: Utpad wali vidhi mein har charan mein nayi jodi gayi keemat tatha saaman ke beech ke phark ko joda jaata hai; isliye ise value added wali vidhi bhi kaha jaata hai. Teesra vikalp sahi hai, jo utpad wali vidhi ko is tarah batata hai. Yah vidhi isliye kaam aati hai ki ek hi cheez do baar ginne ki galti ise theek kar deti hai; isliye kheti, karkhane tatha sevaon ke charanon ka jod isse hota hai. Aay wali vidhi kamai ginnti hai, vyay wali vidhi kharch ginnti hai tatha nivesh ko alag tarika maan lena galti hoti hai, kyunki uska aakda vyay wali vidhi mein hi aata hai. Baaki vikalp is vidhi ke nahi hain. Exam point: utpad wali vidhi har charan mein jodi gayi keemat ginti hai - isliye ise value added wali vidhi kehte hain.

qe: Which of the following is part of the 'Tertiary Sector' in National Income?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आय में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'तृतीयक क्षेत्र' का हिस्सा है?
e: Rashtriy aay ke hisaab mein banking tatha bima ka kaam sevaon wale teesre kshetra ke andar aata hai, kyunki ye sirf suvidha dete hain aur koi saaman nahi banate. Doosra vikalp sahi hai, jo banking tatha bima ko teesre kshetra mein rakhta hai. Inhe alag isliye ginte hain ki bina bank ke vyapar tatha bachat ka paisa nahi chalta; isliye is kshetra ka hissa aaj desh ki aay mein sabse bada hai. Jangal se kaam lena tatha machhli pakadna pehle kshetra ke kaam hain tatha kapda bunana doosre kshetra ka kaam hai, isliye ye teeno yahan nahi aate. Baaki vikalp is kshetra ke nahi hain. Exam point: banking tatha bima teesre kshetra ka hissa hain - yahi aaj ka badhne wala bada kshetra hai.

qe: What is 'Transfer Earning'?
qh: 'हस्तांतरण अर्जन' क्या है?
o: Minimum payment required to keep a factor in its current use
e: Hastantaran arjan wo kam se kam rakam hai jo kisi sadhan ko apne maujooda kaam mein bane rahne ke liye deni padti hai; iske upar jo mile use adhik labh kaha jaata hai. Doosra vikalp sahi hai, jo kam se kam zaroori bhugtan batata hai. Is dhaarna se prayog ke badle diye jaane wale bhugtan tatha us sadhan ki doosri jagah wali kimmat ka phark saaf dikhta hai. Company se mila inaam, karobar ka labh tatha koi nahi wala vikalp is dhaarna se jude nahi hain. Baaki vikalp is dhaarna ke dayre se baahar hain. Exam point: hastantaran arjan wo kam se kam rakam hai jisse sadhan apne kaam par bana rahe - ise yaad rakhein.

qe: What is 'GDP at Factor Cost'?
qh: 'साधन लागत पर जीडीपी' क्या है?
o: GDP at Market Price minus Indirect Taxes plus Subsidies
e: Sadhan laagat par GDP nikaalne ke liye bazaar keemat wali GDP mein se apratyaksh kar ghatakar sabsidi jodi jaati hai, taaki utpadak ki asli laagat dikhe. Doosre vikalp mein sadhan laagat par GDP ka yahi bhar likha hai. Yah sudhaar isliye kiya jaata hai ki bazaar ki keematon mein sarkari kar ghusa hota hai, jo utpadak ke haath nahi aata; isliye us kar ko hataane par hi asli laagat samajh aati hai. GDP mein mulya-kshaya jodna tatha GNP mein se videshi sadhan aay ghatana anya sootra hain tatha kul niryat is sootra ka hissa nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp sadhan laagat ke hisaab se nahi baithte. Exam point: sadhan laagat par GDP = bazaar keemat wali GDP ghata apratyaksh kar jod sabsidi - ise yaad rakhein.

qe: Which component is included in the 'Income Method' of calculating National Income?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आय की गणना की 'आय पद्धति' में निम्नलिखित में से किसे शामिल किया जाता है?
e: Aay wali vidhi mein utpadan ke sabhi sadhanon ki kamai jodi jaati hai, tatha ismein swayamrozgar walon ki mishrit aay bhi shaamil hoti hai, kyunki unmein shram tatha punji alag nahi ki ja sakti. Teesre vikalp mein swayamrozgar walon ki mishrit aay sahi chuni gayi hai. Mishrit aay ko alag dikhane ki zarurat isliye padti hai ki chhote karobar mein maalik khud hi mazdoor tatha punji dono hota hai; isliye uski kamai ko tankha tatha labh mein baantna mushkil hota hai. Niji antim khapat vyay tatha sarkari antim kharch vyay wali vidhi mein aate hain tatha shuddh niryat bhi vyay ka hissa hai, isliye ye teeno aay wali vidhi ke nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp aay wali vidhi mein nahi ginte. Exam point: mishrit aay swayamrozgar walon ki kamai hai - ise aay wali vidhi mein joda jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Consumption of Fixed Capital' in national accounting?
qh: 'अचल पूंजी का उपभोग' क्या है?
e: Achal punji ka upbhog mulya-kshaya ka doosra naam hai, yaani saal bhar mein mashin tatha imaarat ke ghisi-chuk hone se punji ke mulya mein hui kami. Teesre vikalp mein achhal punji ke upbhog ko mulya-kshaya kaha gaya hai. Ise alag dikhane ki zarurat isliye hai ki kul utpadan se is ghisvat ko ghatakar hi shuddh utpadan tatha asli kamai ka pata chalta hai. Rashtriy karz, apratyaksh kar tatha nivesh is ghisvat ke sahi naam nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp ghisi punji ke nuksan se jude nahi hain. Exam point: achal punji ka upbhog = mulya-kshaya - yahi shuddh aakde nikaalne ka rasta hai.

qe: If 'Net Factor Income from Abroad' is zero, then:
qh: यदि 'विदेशों से प्राप्त शुद्ध साधन आय' शून्य है, तो:
e: Jab videsh se milne wali shuddh sadhan aay shunya ho jaati hai, tab GDP tatha GNP ka aakda ek hi ho jaata hai, kyunki jodne ke liye kuch bachta hi nahi. Doosre vikalp mein GDP tatha GNP ko barabar dikhaya gaya hai. Yah sthiti isliye samajh aa jaati hai ki GNP keval GDP mein videshi kamai jodkar banta hai; isliye jod shunya hone par dono barabar rehte hain. NDP tatha NNP ka joda bazaar keemat se juda hai tatha GDP ke GNP se bade ya chhote hone wale vikalp is sthiti mein sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp is barabari se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: shunya videshi sadhan aay par GDP tatha GNP barabar ho jaate hain - yahi sabse aasan niyam hai.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Flow' variable in economics?
qh: अर्थशास्त्र में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'प्रवाह' (Flow) चर है?
e: Pravaah char yaani Flow variable wo hota hai jise samay ke saath naapa jaata hai, jaise rashtriy aay tatha paise ki aapurti; isliye iska koi ek sthir aakda nahi hota. Doosre vikalp mein rashtriy aay ko pravaah char bataya gaya hai. Pravaah ko samay ki lambai ke saath jodkar dekha jaata hai, jaise ek saal ki kamai; isliye yah ek saal mein bahne wali dhaar dikhata hai. Daulat tatha punji ka bhandar sthir char hain, kyunki ye kisi ek samay par ek hi aakda dikhate hain, isliye ye pravaah nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp samay ke saath nahi bahate. Exam point: rashtriy aay pravaah char hai tatha daulat sthir char - yahi bhed aksar poochha jaata hai.

qe: Which of the following transactions is NOT included in GDP?
qh: जीडीपी में निम्नलिखित में से किसे शामिल नहीं किया जाता है?
o: Services of a paid domestic maid
e: Kaale bazaar ki kaarwai tatha anya chhupe kaam GDP mein nahi gine jaate, kyunki inka koi sarkari hisaab nahi hota tatha inki keemat naapna mushkil hai. Chauthe vikalp mein kaale bazaar ki kaarwai sahi chuni gayi hai. Aise kaam ko chhodne se aakda saaf rehta hai, halaanki iska asar aarthik zindagi par padta hai; isliye khufia kaam alag se nahi jode jaate. Khud ke khaane ke liye ugayi fasal, tankhwah wali ghar ki madad tatha sarkari kaam par kharch teeno vaidh utpadan ya kharch hain, isliye ye teeno ginti mein aate hain. Yah teeno vikalp khule hisaab ka hissa hain. Exam point: chhupa kaam GDP se baahar rehta hai - kyunki uska koi sarkari record nahi hota.

qe: Which of the following is an example of 'Final Goods'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'अंतिम वस्तु' का उदाहरण है?
o: Cotton used by a spinning mill
Sugar used by a sweet shop
e: Antim vastu wo cheez hoti hai jo apni antim upyog wali jagah par pahunch jaati hai, jaise ghar dwara kharida gaya doodh, jo seedha piya jaata hai. Pehle vikalp mein ghar dwara kharide doodh ka udaharan sahi baithta hai. Aisi cheez ki keemat ginti mein isliye aa sakti hai ki yah aage kisi bade ug maal mein nahi lagti; isliye yah antim khapat ki vastu hai. Carpenter ka kath, kapda bunne wali mill ka kapas tatha mithai ki dukaan ki cheeni aage lagne wale saaman hain, isliye ye teeno antim vastu ke nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp aage ki banawat mein lag jaate hain. Exam point: ghar ka doodh antim vastu hai tatha mill ka kapas nahi - yahi bhed aksar poochha jaata hai.

qe: In National Income accounting, changes in 'Inventory' are treated as part of:
qh: राष्ट्रीय आय लेखांकन में 'इन्वेंट्री' (स्टॉक) में बदलाव को किसमें शामिल किया जाता है?
e: Rashtriy aay ke hisaab mein store wale saamaan yaani inventory mein hui bhar kam nivesh ke andar gini jaati hai, kyunki yah bhi bhavishya mein bikne wala utpadan hai. Teesre vikalp mein store ke saamaan mein bhar ko nivesh bataya gaya hai. Ise nivesh mein ginne ka aadhar yah hai ki abhi bane par abhi na bike maal ka paisa bhi utpadan mein lag chuka hai; isliye uska hisaab nivesh ke raste rakha jaata hai. Khapat, sarkari kharch tatha mulya-kshaya is badlav ki sahi jagahan nahi hain, kyunki ye teeno alag hisson ko dikhate hain. Yah teeno vikalp store ke ghat-badh se jude nahi hain. Exam point: inventory mein badlav nivesh mein ginte hain - yahi ek chhota par aksar poochha jaane wala niyam hai.

qe: What is 'National Disposable Income'?
qh: 'राष्ट्रीय प्रयोज्य आय' (National Disposable Income) क्या है?
o: NNP at Market Price + Net Current Transfers from the rest of the world
e: Rashtriy prayojya aay yaani National Disposable Income nikaalne ke liye bazaar keemat wali NNP mein videsh se mili shuddh chalu hastantaran jodi jaati hai; isliye ismein logon ke paas aayi inaam wali rakam bhi shaamil hoti hai. Teesre vikalp mein rashtriy kharch layak kamai ka sahi sootra diya gaya hai. Yah jod isliye kiya jaata hai ki videsh se bheja gaya sahayata wala paisa bhi logon ki kharch ki taakat badhata hai; isliye ushe aay ke hisaab mein laana zaroori hai. GDP mein sabsidi jodna, koi nahi tatha vyaktiye aay mein se kar ghatana is sootra ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp kharch layak kamai ke sootra se alag hain. Exam point: rashtriy prayojya aay = bazaar keemat wali NNP jod videshi shuddh chalu hastantaran - yahi sootra hai.

qe: Which sector is called the 'Engine of Growth' in the early stages of a developing economy?
qh: शुरुआती दौर में विकासशील अर्थव्यवस्था में किस क्षेत्र को 'विकास का इंजन' कहा जाता है?
e: Shuruaati daur mein vikas ka engine prathmik kshetra yaani kheti tatha khanan maana jaata hai, kyunki tab sabse zyada kaam tatha aay isi se aati hai. Teesre vikalp mein shuruaati daur ke prathmik kshetra ko engine kaha gaya hai. Yah baat isliye sudh hai ki jab tak kheti tatha khanan se paisa nahi aata, tab tak karkhane tatha sevaayein khadi nahi ho sakti; isliye shuruat inhi kshetron se hoti hai. Videshi kshetra, teesra kshetra tatha doosra kshetra baad ke daur mein aage aate hain, isliye shuruaati engine ke sahi naam ye nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp baad ke daur ki kahani hain. Exam point: shuruaati daur ka engine prathmik kshetra hota hai - baad mein doosra tatha teesra kshetra aage aata hai.

qe: Which of the following is NOT included in National Income via the 'Income Method'?
qh: आय पद्धति के माध्यम से राष्ट्रीय आय में निम्नलिखित में से किसे शामिल नहीं किया जाता है?
e: Aay wali vidhi mein loteree jaise anchaanik labh nahi jode jaate, kyunki ye kisi utpadan ka badla nahi hote tatha achanak mil jaate hain. Doosre vikalp mein loteree jaise anchaanik labh sahi chune gaye hain. Yah chhodaav isliye kiya jaata hai ki aay wali vidhi keval kaam ke badle mili kamai ginnti hai; isliye bina kaam mile paisa ismein nahi aata. Kiraya, byaj tatha tankha utpadan ke sadhanon ki asli kamaiyan hain, isliye ye teeno aay wali vidhi mein aate hain. Yah teeno vikalp kaam ke badle mile bhugtan hain. Exam point: loteree ka paisa aay wali vidhi mein nahi aata - yahi anchaanik labh ka matlab hai.

qe: What is the relationship between 'Gross' and 'Net' values in national accounting?
qh: 'सकल' (Gross) और 'शुद्ध' (Net) मानों के बीच क्या संबंध है?
e: Sakal yaani Gross tatha shuddh yaani Net aakdon ka rishta yah hai ki shuddh aakda nikaalne ke liye sakal aakde mein se mulya-kshaya ghatayi jaati hai. Teesra vikalp mulya-kshaya ghatane ka rishta sahi dikhata hai. Aisa ghatav isliye kiya jaata hai ki sakal aakde mein punji ki ghisvat shaamil hoti hai; isliye asli badhotri dekhne ke liye ushe hataana padta hai. Shuddh ko sakal jod sabsidi batana, shuddh ko sakal ghata videshi sadhan aay batana tatha shuddh ko sakal jod kar batana teeno rishte galat hain. Yah teeno jod sakal tatha shuddh ke banti se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: shuddh = sakal ghata mulya-kshaya - yahi sakal tatha shuddh ka ekmatra banti hai.

qe: What constitutes 'Operating Surplus' in factor income calculation?
qh: 'परिचालन अधिशेष' (Operating Surplus) क्या है?
e: Parichalan adhishesh yaani Operating Surplus ka matlab hai kiraya, byaj tatha labh ka jod, jo utpadan ke sadhanon ke maalikon ko bina mehnat ke bhag ke milta hai. Teesra vikalp kiraya, byaj tatha labh ka jod sahi batata hai. Ise alag ginne se pata chalta hai ki mehnat ke bhugtan tatha punji tatha zameen ke bhugtan ka hissa kitna hai; isliye karkhane ke khaate ka saaf chitra milta hai. Mazdooron ka tankha, koi nahi tatha kul bikri wali rakam is adhishesh ke sahi naam nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp parichalan adhishesh se alag hain. Exam point: parichalan adhishesh = kiraya jod byaj jod labh - yahi shram ke bagair milne wali kamai hai.

qe: Which of the following is NOT a primary 'Factor of Production'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'उत्पादन का कारक' नहीं है?
e: Utpadan ke asli chaar kaar hain - zameen, shram, punji tatha sangathak; isliye bank ka karz inmein nahi aata, kyunki karz to khareed ki taakat deta hai, apne aap utpadan nahi karta. Chauthe vikalp mein bank ke karz ko galti se kaar bataya gaya hai. Karj ka paisa lagane wala udyami tatha shram hi asli kaar hote hain; isliye srot na hone par bhi karz se kaam nahi chalta. Zameen, shram tatha punji teeno asli kaar hain, isliye yah galat vikalp nahi ban sakte. Yah teeno vikalp utpadan ke asli hisse hain. Exam point: bank ka karz utpadan ka kaar nahi hai - asli kaar zameen, shram, punji tatha sangathak hain.

qe: What is 'Imputed Rent' in National Income accounting?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आय में 'आरोपित किराया' (Imputed Rent) क्या है?
o: Rent paid directly to a landlord
e: Aaropit kiraya yaani Imputed Rent khud ke ghar mein rehne wale vyakti ke ghar ka anuman lagaya gaya kiraya hota hai, jo bikri ke hisaab mein na hone par bhi rashtriy aay mein joda jaata hai. Chauthe vikalp mein khud ke ghar ke anumanit kiraye ko sahi kaha gaya hai. Ise ginne ka aadhar yah hai ki kiraye wale ghar tatha apne ghar mein rehne wale ghar ki suvidha ek hi hai; isliye dono ka hisaab barabar rakhna padta hai. Bikaye hue dukaan ka kiraya, maalik ko chukaya gaya kiraya tatha koi bhi gairkanuni kiraya is anuman ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp asli bhugtan wale kiraye hain. Exam point: aaropit kiraya khud ke ghar ka lagaya gaya anuman hai - isse sahi tulna hoti hai.

qe: Which of the following is an example of an activity in the 'Quaternary Sector'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'चतुर्थक क्षेत्र' (Quaternary Sector) का उदाहरण है?
e: Chauthe kshetra yaani Quaternary Sector mein soochana tatha khoj ke kaam aate hain, jaise IT tatha vaigyanik khoj, jahan gyaan hi asli utpadan hota hai. Chauthe vikalp mein IT tatha vaigyanik khoj ka udaharan sahi baithta hai. Yah kshetra teesre kshetra se aage isliye mana jaata hai ki yahan suvidha nahi, gyaan tatha soochana bechi jaati hai; isliye aaj ki arthvyavastha mein iski ahmiyat badh rahi hai. Kheti, imaarat banana tatha machhli pakadna pehle tatha doosre kshetra ke kaam hain, isliye ye teeno chauthe kshetra ke nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp gyaan wale kaam se alag hain. Exam point: chauthe kshetra mein IT tatha khoj ka kaam aata hai - yahi gyaan wali arthvyavastha ki pehchan hai.

qe: In National Income accounting, 'Subsidies' are:
qh: राष्ट्रीय आय लेखांकन में 'सब्सिडी' क्या है?
o: Financial assistance from government to producers to keep market prices lower
e: Sabsidi sarkar dwara utpadkon ko di jaane wali aarthik sahayata hoti hai, taaki zaruri saamaan tatha sevaayein aam aadmi ko sasti keemat par milein. Teesre vikalp mein sarkari sahayata se keemat kaabu wali baat sahi hai. Yah sahayata aay ke hisaab mein ghatane wali cheez hoti hai; isliye bazaar keemat tatha laagat ke beech ka phark sudharne ka kaam karti hai. Koi nahi, apratyaksh kar tatha sarkari udyogon ka labh is sahayata ke sahi naam nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp sasti keemat wali sahayata se jude nahi hain. Exam point: sabsidi utpadkon ko milne wali sarkari sahayata hai - isse aam aadmi ko sasta saaman milta hai.

qe: What is 'Factor Income'?
qh: 'साधन आय' (Factor Income) क्या है?
o: Income earned by owners of factors of production for productive services
e: Sadhan aay yaani Factor Income utpadan ke sadhanon ke maalikon ko unki seva ke badle milne wali kamai hoti hai, jaise khet ka kiraya, punji ka byaj tatha mazdoor ki tankha. Teesre vikalp mein kaam ke badle sadhanon ki kamai sahi batayi gayi hai. Yah kamai rashtriy aay mein isliye jodi jaati hai ki iske badle koi vastu ya seva paida hoti hai; isliye ye hastantaran bhugtan se alag hai. Koi nahi, videsh se mila tohfa tatha jugaar ka paisa is kamai ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp utpadan ke badle ki kamai se alag hain. Exam point: sadhan aay kaam ke badle mile bhugtan hai - ise hastantaran bhugtan se alag rakhein.

qe: Which of the following models describes the 'Circular Flow of Income' in an economy?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 'आय के चक्रीय प्रवाह' का वर्णन करता है?
o: Flow of tax collections to the treasury
Flow of currency between RBI and commercial banks
Flow of goods, services, and factor payments between Households and Firms
e: Aay ka chakriya pravaah gharon tatha firmon ke beech saaman, sevaon tatha sadhan bhugtanon ke ghoomne ko dikhata hai; isliye ek jagah ka kharch doosri jagah ki aay banta hai. Teesre vikalp mein gharon tatha firmon ka chakra sahi dikhaya gaya hai. Is chakre se saaf pata chalta hai ki kharch tatha aay ek doosre se jude hain; isliye ek jagah kamai ghatne ka asar poori arthvyavastha par padta hai. Kar ka paisa khazane mein jana tatha mudra ka RBI tatha bankon ke beech ghoomna alag pravaah hain, isliye ye teeno is chakra ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp chakriya pravaah se alag hain. Exam point: ghar tatha firm ke beech saaman tatha bhugtan ka ghoomna aay ka chakriya pravaah hai.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Stock' variable in economic analysis?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'स्टॉक' (Stock) चर है?
e: Sthir char yaani Stock wo hota hai jise kisi ek samay par naapa jaata hai, jaise rashtriy daulat, jismein desh ki saari sampatti ek saath gini jaati hai. Doosre vikalp mein rashtriy daulat ko sthir char bataya gaya hai. Sthir aakda ek hi pal ki tasveer deta hai, isliye usmein samay ke saath bahav nahi hota; isliye daulat tatha punji bhandar ismein aate hain. Roz ka byaj, saal ki aay tatha mahine ka utpadan samay ke saath bahne wale aakde hain, isliye ye sthir char ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp samay ke saath badalte rehte hain. Exam point: rashtriy daulat sthir char hai tatha saal ki aay pravaah - yahi bhed aksar poochha jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Mixed Income' in the income method?
qh: आय पद्धति में 'मिश्रित आय' (Mixed Income) क्या है?
o: Combined income of self-employed individuals where labor and capital cannot be separated
e: Mishrit aay yaani Mixed Income swayamrozgar logon ki woh kamai hai jismein unki mehnat tatha lagayi gayi punji ka hissa alag nahi kiya ja sakta, jaise kisan ya chhote dukaandar ki kamai. Pehla vikalp mishrit kamai ka matlab sahi batata hai. Bina ise alag dikhaye aay wali vidhi mein tankha tatha labh ka hisaab adhura reh jaata hai. Videshi anudaan ki kamai, koi nahi tatha badi companyon ki kamai is shabd ke sahi matlab nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp mishrit kamai se alag hain. Exam point: mishrit aay swayamrozgar ki woh kamai hai jismein mehnat tatha punji alag nahi hoti.

qe: What is 'Gross Domestic Capital Formation' (GDCF)?
qh: 'सकल घरेलू पूंजी निर्माण' (GDCF) क्या है?
o: Total addition to fixed assets and change in stock (Investment)
e: Sakal gharelu punji nirman yaani GDCF ka matlab hai desh ke andar punji banane par hua poora kharch, jismein mashinein, imaaratein tatha store ke saaman mein bhar shaamil hota hai. Teesra vikalp punji nirman wala poora jod sahi dikhata hai. Ise sankshep mein nivesh kaha jaata hai tatha yah badhotri ka engine hota hai; isliye iske ghatne par rozgar tatha aay dono par asar padta hai. Videshi mudra ka bhandar, koi nahi tatha kul bachat is punji nirman ke sahi naam nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp poore punji nirman se alag hain. Exam point: sakal gharelu punji nirman = purani sampatti mein jod jod store mein bhar - yahi nivesh ka poora aakda hai.

qe: What is the formula for the 'GDP Deflator'?
qh: 'जीडीपी डिफ्लेटर' का सूत्र क्या है?
e: GDP difletar nikaalne ke liye chalu keematon wali GDP ko aadhaar saal ki keematon wali GDP se baantkar sau se guna kiya jaata hai. Pehla vikalp difletar ka sahi hisaab kram deta hai. Yah anupat isliye kaam aata hai ki dono aakdon ka phark hi keematon ke badhav ko dikhata hai; isliye sau guna bhag ka matlab mehngai ka saalana naap ban jaata hai. Koi nahi, GDP mein mehngai jodna tatha ulta banta lena is sootra ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp difletar ke hisaab kram se alag hain. Exam point: GDP difletar = chalu keemat wali GDP baanti aadhaar keemat wali GDP guna sau.

qe: What is 'Intermediate Consumption'?
qh: 'मध्यवर्ती खपत' (Intermediate Consumption) क्या है?
o: Value of goods and services used up as inputs in the production process
e: Madhyavarti khapat yaani Intermediate Consumption ka matlab hai utpadan ke dauraan lagne wale saaman tatha sevaon ki kimmat, jo antim maal mein hi shaamil ho jaati hai. Chauthe vikalp mein utpadan mein lagne wale saaman ki kimmat sahi batayi gayi hai. Ise antim khapat se alag rakhna isliye zaroori hai ki warna ek hi cheez ki ginti do baar ho jaayegi; isliye yah aakda madhya padav ka kharch dikhata hai. Ghar ki bank bachat, koi nahi tatha antim vastu par kharch is madhya khapat ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp madhyavarti lagne se alag hain. Exam point: madhyavarti khapat utpadan mein lagne wale saaman ki kimmat hai - ise antim khapat se alag rakhein.

qe: What is the 'Economic Territory' of a country in national accounting?
qh: किसी देश का 'आर्थिक क्षेत्र' (Economic Territory) क्या है?
o: Geographical territory plus ships, aircraft, and embassies abroad run by residents
e: Kisi desh ke aarthik chhetra yaani Economic Territory mein uski bhugol seema ke saath videsh mein chalne wale uske jaaz, hawaai jahaaz tatha dootavaas bhi gine jaate hain, kyunki ve desh ke nivasiyon ke hi hote hain. Doosra vikalp aarthik chhetra ki chaudai sahi dikhata hai. Yah chaudai isliye rakhni padti hai ki seema ke baahar chalne wale desh ke jaaz tatha dootavaas bhi desh ki aay ka hissa hote hain; isliye unhe chhodne se aakda adhura ho jaata hai. Sirf udyog wale ilaake, sirf zameen ki seema tatha koi nahi wale vikalp is chaudai ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp aarthik chhetra se chhote hain. Exam point: aarthik chhetra mein jaaz, hawaai jahaaz tatha videshi dootavaas bhi shaamil hote hain.

qe: If 'GDP at Market Price' is 1000 and 'Net Indirect Taxes' is 200, what is 'GDP at Factor Cost'?
qh: यदि 'बाजार मूल्य पर जीडीपी' 1000 है और 'शुद्ध अप्रत्यक्ष कर' 200 है, तो 'साधन लागत पर जीडीपी' क्या होगी?
e: Yadi bazaar keemat par GDP hazaar rupaye hai tatha shuddh apratyaksh kar do sau rupaye hai, to sadhan laagat par GDP aath sau rupaye hogi, kyunki bazaar keemat se kar ghataya jaata hai. Chauthe vikalp mein aath sau ka aakda sahi nikala gaya hai. Yah ganit isliye hota hai ki utpadak ki laagat tatha bazaar ki keemat ke beech kar ka phark hota hai; isliye bazaar keemat se kar hataakar hi asli laagat nikalti hai. Paanch sau, ek hazaar tatha baarah sau wale aakde jode-ghataye ke is ganit se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno aakde is hisaab se galat nikalte hain. Exam point: bazaar keemat par GDP se shuddh apratyaksh kar ghatane par sadhan laagat par GDP milti hai - yahan jawab aath sau hai.

qe: Who is considered the 'Father of National Income Accounting'?
qh: 'राष्ट्रीय आय लेखांकन का जनक' किसे माना जाता है?
e: Rashtriy aay hisaab kitaab ka janak Simon Kuznets ko maana jaata hai, kyunki unhone aakde jodne ka poora tarika taya kiya. Pehla vikalp is pad ke liye Simon Kuznets ko chunta hai. Yah aadmi isliye yaad kiya jaata hai ki unke tarike se deshon ki tulna sambhav hui; isliye aaj bhi rashtriy aay ke aakde unhi ke dhaanche par bandhte hain. John Maynard Keynes rozgaar tatha maang ke vichaarak the, Alfred Marshall keematein samjhane wale the tatha Adam Smith ko dhanda siddhaant ka bada naam maana jaata hai, isliye ye is pad ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno naam anya kaam ke liye jaane jaate hain. Exam point: rashtriy aay hisaab ka janak Simon Kuznets hain - unhi ne poora tarika banaya.

qe: In which city is the 'National Statistical Office' (NSO) headquartered?
qh: 'राष्ट्रीय सांख्यिकी कार्यालय' (NSO) का मुख्यालय किस शहर में है?
e: Rastriya saankhyiki karyalaya ka mukhya daftar nayi dilli mein sthit hai, jahan se desh ke GDP tatha anya bade aakde jaari hote hain. Chauthe vikalp mein nayi dilli ko thek adresa bataya gaya hai. Yah daftar isliye wahan hai ki niti banane wali sansthaayein tatha mantralaya bhi wahin hain; isliye aakde tatha niti ke faisle ke beech ka taalmel aasan hota hai. Mumbai, Kolkata tatha Bengaluru mein desh ki anya badi sansthaayein hain, par saankhyiki karyalaya ka mukhya daftar nahi. Yah teeno sheher anya sansthaon ke liye jaane jaate hain. Exam point: NSO ka mukhya daftar New Delhi mein hai - isi jagah se bade aakde aate hain.

qe: Which of the following is an example of an 'Indirect Tax'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'अप्रत्यक्ष कर' का उदाहरण है?
e: Apratyaksh kar wo hota hai jo saaman tatha sevaon ki bikri par lagta hai tatha grahak ushe keemat ke saath chuka deta hai, jaise GST. Doosre vikalp mein GST ko apratyaksh kar sahi kaha gaya hai. Aise kar ka bojh aage badhta rehta hai tatha vasooli keval bikri par hoti hai; isliye ise janata ka kharch wala kar bhi kaha jaata hai. Corporate Tax, Income Tax tatha Wealth Tax aay tatha sampatti par seedhe lagne wale kar hain, isliye ve apratyaksh nahi hain. Yah teeno kar pratyaksh jaati ke hain. Exam point: GST apratyaksh kar hai tatha aay par lagne wale kar pratyaksh - yahi bhed aksar poochha jaata hai.

qe: What does the 'Consumer Price Index' (CPI) measure in India?
qh: 'उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक' (CPI) का उपयोग क्या मापने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Upbhokta molya soochakank grahakon ko bazaar mein rozana ke samaan par aane wali mehngai ka naap dikhata hai. Pehla vikalp upbhokta molya soochakank ka sahi kaam batata hai. Is soochakank ko isliye sabse ahem maana jaata hai ki isi ke aakde par bhaav ke faisle tatha mehnat ke samjhau tay hote hain; isliye iski badhotri seedha aam aadmi ki jeb par chot karti hai. Niryat ki matra, bazaar ke share ka chalan tatha karkhane ke thok bhaav is soochakank ke sahi kaam nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp bhaav ki gaflat se jude hain. Exam point: CPI khanddar mehngai naapta hai - isi ke aakde par bhaav tatha tankha ke faisle bandhte hain.

qe: What is the relationship between 'Gross Value Added' (GVA) and 'GDP' at Market Prices?
qh: 'सकल मूल्य वर्धन' (GVA) और 'जीडीपी' (GDP) के बीच क्या संबंध है?
o: GDP = GVA at basic prices + Product Taxes - Product Subsidies
e: Sakal molya vardhan tatha GDP ka rishta yah hai ki buniyadi keemat wali GVA mein utpad kar jode jaate hain tatha utpad sabsidi ghatayi jaati hai. Pehla vikalp yahi rishta sahi likhta hai. Yah jod-ghatav isliye kiya jaata hai ki GVA laagat ke kareeb hoti hai tatha GDP bazaar ki keemat dikhata hai; isliye dono ko jodne ke liye utpadon par lagne wale kar tatha sabsidi ko samayojit kiya jaata hai. Koi nahi, GVA mein se shuddh apratyaksh kar ghatana tatha GVA mein mulya-kshaya jodna is rishte ke sahi sootra nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp GVA tatha GDP ke jod se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: GDP = buniyadi keemat wali GVA jod utpad kar ghata utpad sabsidi - yahi aaj ka chalan sootra hai.

qe: The merger of which two statistical agencies formed the National Statistical Office (NSO) in 2019?
qh: किन संगठनों के विलय से राष्ट्रीय सांख्यिकी कार्यालय (NSO) का गठन हुआ?
e: Rastriya saankhyiki karyalaya desh ke do purane daftaron - rastriya namoona sarvekshan sangathan tatha kendriya saankhyiki sangathan - ko milakar banaya gaya hai. Teesra vikalp inhi do daftaron ke milaap ko sahi batata hai. Yah milaap isliye kiya gaya ki aakde jodne tatha sarvekshan ke kaam ek hi chhat ke neeche aayein; isliye ab GDP tatha anya naapon ka aakda ek hi jagah se aata hai. Koi nahi, yojna ayog tatha NITI Aayog ka milaap tatha RBI tatha SBI ka joda is karyalaya ke banne ki kahani nahi hai. Yah teeno jode is karyalaya ke janm se jude nahi hain. Exam point: NSO NSSO tatha CSO ke milaap se bana - yahi do purane daftar the.

qe: Which of the following represents an activity in the 'Quinary Sector'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'पंचम क्षेत्र' (Quinary Sector) की गतिविधि का उदाहरण है?
o: Highest-level policy and strategic decision-making (CEOs / Senior government officials)
e: Pancham kshetra yaani Quinary Sector mein sabse upar ke niti tatha badi soch ke faisle aate hain, jaise mukhya adhikari tatha bade afsar ke nirnay. Teesra vikalp sabse upar ke faislon ka kaam sahi dikhata hai. Yah kshetra chauthe kshetra ke bhi upar mana jaata hai, kyunki yahan gyaan prapt karke use poore desh ke liye istemal kiya jaata hai; isliye bade sansthaon ke chot ke faisle isi mein aate hain. Adhyapak ka padhana, gaadiyon ka jodai tatha kheti ke kaam neeche ke kshetron ke hain, isliye ye teeno pancham kshetra ke nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp upar ke faislon se alag hain. Exam point: pancham kshetra sabse upar ke niti faisle ka kshetra hai - yahi chauthe kshetra se aage ki seedhi hai.

qe: What is the sector that contributes the largest share (approx. 53-55%) to India's GDP?
qh: भारत की जीडीपी में वर्तमान में किस क्षेत्र का योगदान लगभग 53-55% है?
e: Bharat ki GDP mein teesre kshetra ka hissa pachaas se pachpan pratishat ke aas-paas hai; isliye desh ki aay ka aadha hissa sevaon se hi aata hai. Chauthe vikalp teesre kshetra ka sahi hissa dikhata hai. Yah hissa isliye itna bada hai ki bank, vyapar, transport tatha soochana jaise kaam sabse tez badhte hain; isliye rozgar tatha aay dono mein inka hissa sabse aage hai. Khanan, doosra kshetra tatha prathmik kshetra is hisse se bahut peeche hain, isliye aise bade hisse ke daave unke paksh mein nahi thehrte. Yah teeno vikalp is badi hissedaari se peeche hain. Exam point: GDP mein teesre kshetra ka hissa karib 53 se 55 pratishat hai - yahi bharat ki arthvyavastha ka bada stambh hai.

qe: Which method of calculating National Income is also called the 'Industrial Origin Method'?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आय गणना की किस पद्धति को 'औद्योगिक मूल पद्धति' भी कहा जाता है?
e: Utpad wali vidhi ko aksar audyogik mool vidhi bhi kehte hain, kyunki isme har udyog tatha charan mein nayi jodi gayi keemat ko joda jaata hai. Chauthe vikalp isi naam ko sahi dikhata hai. Yah naam isliye pada ki ismein kheti, karkhane tatha sevaon ke sabhi hisson ka utpadan alag-alag dekha jaata hai; isliye poore desh ka utpad ek saath jodkar aay nikaali jaati hai. Aay wali vidhi kamai ginnti hai, koi nahi wala vikalp galat hai tatha vyay wali vidhi kharch ko jodti hai, isliye ye teeno is naam ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya naam tatha tarike se jude hain. Exam point: utpad wali vidhi ko audyogik mool vidhi bhi kehte hain - yahi charan dar charan utpadan jodti hai.

qe: Which item is excluded when calculating National Income through the Expenditure Method?
qh: व्यय विधि के माध्यम से राष्ट्रीय आय में निम्नलिखित में से किसे शामिल नहीं किया जाता है?
o: Expenditure on purchase of second-hand goods
e: Vyay wali vidhi mein kuch kharch nahi jode jaate, jaise purane maal ko kharidne par hua kharch, kyunki aisa saaman pehle hi ginti mein aa chuka hota hai. Teesra vikalp purane maal ke kharch ko sahi chhunta hai. Aise kharch ko chhodne ka aadhar yah hai ki purani cheez ka utpadan pichhle saalon mein ho chuka hai; isliye use dobara jodne se ginti bigad jaayegi. Sakal gharelu punji nirman, shuddh niryat tatha sarkari antim kharch is vidhi ke asli hisse hain, isliye ye galat vikalp nahi ban sakte. Yah teeno vikalp vyay ke asli hisse hain. Exam point: purane maal par kharch vyay wali vidhi mein nahi joda jaata - kyunki uski ginti pehle hi ho chuki hai.

qe: What is 'Compensation of Employees' in the Income Method?
qh: आय पद्धति में 'कर्मचारियों का पारिश्रमिक' क्या है?
o: Wages and salaries in cash and kind, plus employer contributions to social security schemes
e: Karmchariyon ka parishramik wo poora bhugtan hai jo karmchari ko nagad tatha saaman ke roop mein milta hai, sath hi sarkari suraksha yojna mein diya gaya malik ka hissa bhi. Doosra vikalp iske sabhi hisson ko sahi dikhata hai. Yah hissa aay wali vidhi ka sabse bada hissa hota hai; isliye ismein bonus, bhatta tatha pension jaisi sahayataayein bhi ginni padti hain. Keval tyohaar ka inaam, keval nagad ki tankha tatha koi nahi wale vikalp is bhugtan ke adhure roop hain. Yah teeno vikalp parishramik ke poore aakde se kam hain. Exam point: karmchariyon ka parishramik nagad, saaman tatha malik ke yogdaan sab jodkar banta hai.

qe: Who coined the phrase 'Hindu Rate of Growth' to describe India's pre-1980s economic performance?
qh: भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए 'हिंदू विकास दर' का सुझाव किसने दिया था?
e: Hindu vikas dar ka naam Raj Krishna ne diya tha; isse matlab tha ki desh ki badhotri ek hi dhar par thami rahti hai, na bahut tez na bahut dheemi. Doosra vikalp Raj Krishna ke naam ko sahi chhunta hai. Yah shabd isliye mashhoor hua ki saal-dar-saal badhotri ek hi seema ke aas-paas ghoomti rahi; isliye isne bharat ki dheemi taraqqi ka naksha saaf kiya. Amartya Sen tatha Manmohan Singh baad ke samay ke bade aarthik vichaarak hain tatha V.K.R.V. Rao rashtriy aay ke aguva the, isliye yah naam is shabd ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno naam is shabd se jude nahi hain. Exam point: hindu vikas dar ka sujhav Raj Krishna ne diya - yahi dheemi badhotri ka mashhoor naam hai.

qe: Which major sector of the Indian economy maintained positive real growth during the COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns?
qh: कोविड-19 महामारी के दौरान भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के किस क्षेत्र ने सकारात्मक वृद्धि दिखाई?
e: Kovid kaaleen visham paristhiti mein bharat mein kheti tatha usse jude kaam hi aise kshetra the jinhone badhotri dikhai; isliye logon ka khaana tatha gaon ka rozgar bacha raha. Pehla vikalp kheti ke sahi hone ko dikhata hai. Yah sthiti isliye bani ki karkhane tatha daftar band the par kheti ka kaam khule mein chalta raha; isliye gaon ki taraf log lautey tatha kheti ka hissa badha. Karkhane, vimaan tatha sevaon wale khaane is dauraan neeche gaye the, isliye ye teeno sahi vikalp nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp kovid kaaleen mandi ki kahani hain. Exam point: kovid kaaleen kheti tatha jude kaam hi badhe - yahi us samay ka badhotri wala kshetra tha.

qe: Which office under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry compiles and releases the Wholesale Price Index (WPI)?
qh: भारत में 'थोक मूल्य सूचकांक' (WPI) के लिए डेटा कौन प्रदान करता है?
e: Thok bhaav soochakank ke aakde aarthik salahkar ke daftar se aate hain, jo udyog tatha aantrik vyapar mantralaya ke adheen kaam karta hai. Chauthe vikalp isi daftar ko sahi batata hai. Yah daftar isliye dekhta hai ki karkhane tatha bade vyapar ke star par keematon ka badlav kaisa hai; isliye thok bhaav ka aakda nagad ke bhaav se pehle badalta hai. NSO khudra bhaav ke aakde dekhta hai, NITI Aayog salah deta hai tatha RBI bankon ka kaam sambhalta hai, isliye ye teeno thok bhaav ke sahi daftar nahi hain. Yah teeno sansthaayein anya kaam dekhti hain. Exam point: WPI aarthik salahkar ke daftar se aata hai - yahi udyog mantralaya ke andar baithta hai.

qe: What is the formula for calculating the 'Value of Output' in the product method?
qh: 'उत्पादन का मूल्य' (Value of Output) का सूत्र क्या है?
e: Utpadan ka molya yaani Value of Output nikaalne ke liye saal bhar ki bikri mein store ke saaman mein hua badlav joda jaata hai; isliye bane par na bike maal ka hisaab bhi ismein aa jaata hai. Doosra vikalp bikri jod store badlav ka sahi sootra deta hai. Yah jod isliye kiya jaata hai ki jab saaman bana tabhi wo utpadan ban gaya, chahe wo beech mein bikar store mein pada rahe; isliye store ka aakda bhi utpadan ka hissa hai. Keemat guna laagat, bikri mein se store ghatana tatha kul labh is sootra ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp utpadan ke molya se alag hain. Exam point: utpadan ka molya = bikri jod store ke saaman mein badlav - yahi sootra hai.

qe: Which economist was the first to estimate India's National Income during the colonial era?
qh: भारत में राष्ट्रीय आय का अनुमान लगाने वाले पहले व्यक्ति कौन थे?
e: Bharat mein sabse pehle rashtriy aay ka anumaan Dadabhai Naoroji ne lagaya tha, tatha unki mashhoor kitaab mein yah poora hisaab chhapa tha. Chauthe vikalp Dadabhai Naoroji ko pehla naam batata hai. Unka anumaan isliye ahem hai ki usne desh ki gareebi tatha dhan ke baahar jaane ka mudda sabke saamne rakha; isliye yah aage ki bahs ka aadhar bana. P.C. Mahalanobis tatha V.K.R.V. Rao baad ke anumaan wale the tatha William Digby ne apne tarike se anumaan lagaya tha, isliye pehla naam ye nahi hain. Yah teeno naam pehle anumaan se aage ke hain. Exam point: pehla rashtriy aay anumaan Dadabhai Naoroji ne diya - unki likhi kitaab ne desh ki gareebi ka mudda sabke saamne rakha.

qe: What is 'GVA at Basic Prices' formula?
qh: 'बुनियादी कीमतों पर GVA' क्या है?
o: GVA at Factor Cost + Production Taxes - Production Subsidies
e: Buniyadi keematon par GVA nikaalne ke liye sadhan laagat wali GVA mein utpadan kar jode jaate hain tatha utpadan par mili sabsidi ghatayi jaati hai. Chauthe vikalp yahi jod-ghatav sahi likhta hai. Aisa jod-ghatav isliye zaroori hai ki utpadan kar laagat ke saath juda hota hai, bikri se nahi; isliye ise GVA mein jodkar hi theek aakda nikalta hai. GNP mein se mulya-kshaya ghatana, koi nahi tatha bazaar keemat par GDP is sootra ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp buniyadi keemat ki GVA se alag hain. Exam point: buniyadi keemat par GVA = sadhan laagat wali GVA jod utpadan kar ghata utpadan sabsidi.

qe: What three core dimensions form the basis of the 'Human Development Index' (HDI)?
qh: 'मानव विकास सूचकांक' (HDI) की गणना किन तीन प्रमुख आयामों के आधार पर की जाती है?
o: Long and healthy life, Knowledge (education), and a decent standard of living (GNI per capita)
Industrial growth, Exports, and Foreign Reserves
Population growth, Military strength, and Area
Agricultural output, Inflation, and Tax collection
e: Manav vikas soochakank teen aayamon par khada hai - lambi tatha swasth zindagi, gyaan yaani padhai tatha jeevan ka theek star, jo pratyek vyakti ki kamai se naapa jaata hai. Pehla vikalp yahi teen aayam sahi ginwata hai. Is soochakank ko isliye mahatva mila ki keval kamai se zyada, logon ka jeevan star dekhna zaroori hai; isliye swasthya tatha padhai ko bhi barabar jagah di jaati hai. Udyog, niryat tatha videshi bhandar wala jod, aabadi tatha sena wala jod tatha kheti tatha mehngai wala jod is soochakank ke aayam nahi hain. Yah teeno jod is soochakank ke gathan se alag hain. Exam point: HDI ke teen aayam - lambi umar, gyaan tatha jeevan ka theek star - yaad rakhein.

qe: Who were the primary economists that formulated the Human Development Index (HDI) framework in 1990?
qh: मानव विकास सूचकांक (HDI) की अवधारणा विकसित करने वाले दो प्रमुख अर्थशास्त्री कौन थे?
o: Mahbub ul Haq and Amartya Sen
John Maynard Keynes and Milton Friedman
e: Manav vikas soochakank ki soch Mahbub ul Haq tatha Amartya Sen ne milkar khadi ki, tatha ise saalana riporat mein pesh kiya gaya. Pehla vikalp inhi do naam ko sahi jodta hai. Yah jodi isliye mashhoor hui ki ek ne naap ka dhaancha banaya tatha doosre ne uske peeche ki soch di; isliye soochakank aaj duniya bhar mein tulna ka zariya bana. Raghuram Rajan tatha Urjit Patel bankon ke kaam se jude hain tatha Adam Smith, David Ricardo, Keynes tatha Friedman anya bade vichaarak the, isliye ye jodi is soochakank ki nahi hai. Yah teeno jodi is soochakank se alag hai. Exam point: HDI ki soch Mahbub ul Haq tatha Amartya Sen ki jodi ne di - yahi vikas ki nayi soch thi.

qe: What does a score of 1.0 represent on the Human Development Index (HDI)?
qh: मानव विकास सूचकांक (HDI) में '1' का स्कोर क्या दर्शाता है?
o: Highest theoretical level of human development
e: Manav vikas soochakank mein ek ka aakda sabse ooncha tatha shunya ka aakda sabse neecha star dikhata hai; isliye ek ka matlab hai sabse behtar manav vikas. Teesra vikalp ek ke aakde ka sahi matlab batata hai. Yah naap isliye asaan hai ki teen aayamon ke aakde milakar shunya se ek ke beech ek hi sankhya mil jaati hai; isliye deshon ki tulna pal bhar mein hoti hai. Beech ka vikas, aarthik kaam ka bilkul khatm hona tatha sabse neecha manav vikas is aakde ke sahi matlab nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp oonche aakde se alag hain. Exam point: HDI mein ek sabse ooncha manav vikas dikhata hai tatha shunya sabse neecha.

qe: Which corporate reporting database replaced the Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) sample in the revised 2011-12 GDP series?
qh: नई आर्थिक श्रृंखला में डेटा सटीकता में सुधार के लिए कॉर्पोरेट मामलों के मंत्रालय (MCA) द्वारा किस डेटाबेस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Nayi aarthik shrinkhla mein companyon ke aakde sudharne ke liye corporate mamlon ke mantralaya ke MCA-21 dhaanche se madad li jaati hai, jismein registered companyon ki vastavik jaankari hoti hai. Pehla vikalp MCA-21 ke aakde ke istemal ko sahi batata hai. Yah dhaancha isliye kaam aata hai ki usmein companyon ke aakde tatha hisaab ki jaankari pehle se hi darj hoti hai; isliye aakde tez tatha kam kharch mein mil jaate hain. NSSO ka udyog sarvekshan, RBI ka company hisaab tatha aay kar ki filein is dhaanche ke sahi naam nahi hain. Yah teeno srot MCA-21 se alag hain. Exam point: MCA-21 companyon ke aakde ka sarkari dhaancha hai - isi se nayi shrinkhla mein sudhar aaya.

qe: What is the key difference between 'Product Taxes' and 'Production Taxes' in the GVA system?
qh: 'उत्पाद कर' (Product Tax) और 'उत्पादन कर' (Production Tax) के बीच मुख्य अंतर क्या है?
o: Production taxes are paid solely by consumers
Product taxes are levied per unit of output (e.g., GST), whereas production taxes are paid regardless of output volume (e.g., land revenue)
There is no distinction in national accounts
Production taxes depend directly on output volume; product taxes do not
e: Utpad kar yaani Product Tax tatha utpadan kar yaani Production Tax mein bada phark yah hai ki utpad kar bikri ke har ikai par lagta hai, jaise GST, jabki utpadan kar utpadan kitna bhi ho, uske hisaab se lagta hai, jaise zameen ka lagaan. Doosra vikalp yahi phark sahi bayaan karta hai. Yah bhed isliye ahem hai ki utpad kar grahak ke bhugtan se juda hota hai tatha utpadan kar udyog ke lagne se; isliye aay jodne ke samay dono ko alag-alag jagahan di jaati hai. Utpadan kar sirf grahakon dwara chukane wali baat, rashtriy hisaab mein koi bhed na hona tatha utpadan kar ko sirf utpadan par nirbhar batana - ye teeno bayaan is phark ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno bayaan is bhed se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: utpad kar bikri ki har ikai par lagta hai tatha utpadan kar utpadan ke hisaab se - yahi phark aksar poochha jaata hai.

qe: How are precious 'Valuables' like gold and art treated in national accounts under revised series guidelines?
qh: संशोधित आर्थिक श्रृंखला में सोने और चांदी जैसी 'कीमती वस्तुओं' (Valuables) के साथ कैसा व्यवहार किया जाता है?
o: Classified as capital formation and part of household physical savings
e: Nayi shrinkhla mein sone-chandi jaisi keemti vastuon yaani Valuables ko punji nirman maana jaata hai tatha ghar ke bhautik saaman ki bachat ka hissa gina jaata hai. Pehla vikalp keemti vastuon ka yahi pehchan sahi deta hai. Yah badlav isliye laaya gaya ki log sone ko bachat ke liye rakhte hain, kharch ke liye nahi; isliye ushe punji mein ginne se aakde sahi banta hai. GDP se poori tarah bahar rakhna, ushe madhyavarti khapat batana tatha sarkari khapat batana - ye teeno bayaan is pehchan ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno bayaan keemti vastuon ki sachchai se alag hain. Exam point: sone-chandi bahut si arthvyavasthaon mein punji nirman tatha ghar ki bhautik bachat maani jaati hai.

qe: What is the policy purpose of 'Land Ceiling' legislation in Indian agrarian reforms?
qh: भूमि सुधार नीतियों में 'लैंड सीलिंग' (Land Ceiling) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Imposing building height limits in rural areas
Legally fixing the maximum agricultural land area that an individual or family can hold
Raising the market price of farmland
e: Bhoomi sudhaar niti mein bhoomi seema yaani Land Ceiling ka matlab hai kanoon dwara vyakti ya parivar ke paas rakhi ja sakne wali kheti ki zameen ki sabse badi seema tay karna. Doosra vikalp bhoomi seema ka yahi matlab batata hai. Is seema ka maksad yah tha ki zameen gine-chune haathon mein na simat jaye; isliye badi jameen wale kheton ka bachra hua hissa chhote kisaano mein baantne ka raasta khula. Gaon mein imaaraton ki oonchai ki rok, company ki kheti par rok tatha zameen ka bazaar bhaav badhana is niti ke sahi matlab nahi hain. Yah teeno bayaan bhoomi seema se alag hain. Exam point: bhoomi seema kanooni tay ki gayi kheti ki zameen ki badi had hai - isse bandobast badla.
